name: Chibi Visitor v4
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modelling
creation_method: Blender 5.1.2, built through the Blender MCP server (Blender Lab extension 1.0.3). The skull relief was worked with Blender sculpt brushes (sculpt_head.py, interactive only; baked to sources/head-sculpt.json); ears, nose, neck, hair, clothing and accessories are procedural Python in generate.py. No image-to-3D service, downloaded mesh, add-on asset or downloaded texture is used. The supplied character sheet is a design reference and is not embedded.

geometry.origin: between the feet on the ground

accuracy_notes: Stylised interpretation of the owner's v4.0 sheet. Head: shallow sculpted relief on the sheet-matched skull silhouette (mean 1.25 mm, p95 6.5 mm from the parametric skull), fused ears/nose/neck and a painted face texture; the facial character is mostly texture. Hair is busier and less smoothly layered than the sheet. Body, hands and shoes are simplified procedural parts. Silhouette rows are mostly within about 2 cm of the sheet with larger flick and tuft deviations. Verified: glTF Validator 0 errors, headless rebuild byte-identical, Three.js load with textured face. Not rigged, not registered in the catalog; gallery viewer acceptance and device performance are not verified.
rights: Original asset; owner-project reuse is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
